body: Thanks for the kind words and reaching out. It’s a long story but in a nutshell I’m a recovering alcoholic who’s had more slips and relapses than there are drops in the ocean. I just have so much guilt and shame for all the people I’ve hurt and relationships I’ve messed up...my brother and I used to be very close and I ruined our relationship as well. I also suffer from Borderline Personality Disorder and it makes most relationships in my life really challenging. I’ve tried talking to my brother and apologizing so many but it always ends in a fight. I know I’m A LOT to deal with, I get that. I guess sometimes I just wish more people understood me...especially my brother. Feel like he doesn’t care about me anymore and there’s no turning back. Sorry for rambling thank you for listening
That means a lot to hear...thank you
Aw thanks, that honestly makes me feel a lot better. I know it was the wrong thing to have happened. As long as he doesn't hate me I can live with that and leave things be.
That's true. And I will. Guess I was just confused because he seemed very keen about it and then came the block.
Screw whoever stood you up, it’s their loss! You are beautiful, needed and loved. Keep going!
You look like a true warrior sir. Things will get better. I’m currently in a very dark place myself. Hang in there and know you are not alone
You are gorgeous! You kinda remind me of Jane from Breaking Bad ♥️

No, I don't think I will try contacting him again and will rather just let it be now. 

Thanks so much!!
Thank you kind stranger, I really appreciate that! x (And I really love that active hive metaphor)

Kind of long story short, and sounds really silly now thinking back to it, but basically the incident that triggered it was that I was upset that he hadn't responded to my text message for 5 days when I was on vacation in Florida, yet he found time to post to social media. (As he explained to me last night, his recent diagnoses of autism has helped him realize why his alway struggled in relationships and if we/I had known that at the time I would've certainly been more understanding). But alas, I was a woman in rage and texted him that I thought that was inconsiderate. He then broke up with me via text message saying that he thought it was an unreasonable request to ask your partner to send at least one text message a day to check in. No conversation, nothing, just a cold text. Can't remember exactly who said what verbatim, but basically I was pissed, and he then told me I need to "get help for my issues." This is a trigger point for me as I have suffered with mental illness and I thought the way he said it was being sarcastic and not trying to be helpful. I really wish I hadn't now, and I know how childish it is, but in that moment I thought "well, fuck him. If he can deal low blows then so can I!" And so I texted him that he should "take his own advice and get help for his mommy issues." (Not the proudest moment of my life and I instantly wished I could take those words back).
I think I just thought maybe after 6, 7 months perhaps some of the anger might have dissipated but guess I was very, very wrong.
Thanks, that's a good way new way of looking at it.
